findings.title: Deferred satisfaction closes the giving course

findings.mechanism: The focus verb's acceptance facet meets the supplied striving, giving, guardedness, and facilitation sequence; the future marker places satisfaction after that course, while the same-surah connections return the course reading to the focus.
findings.reader_payoff: The final promise becomes a destination that gathers the preceding course, rather than an unconnected pleasant feeling.
findings.containment: The ordinary future promise of the righteous subject becoming satisfied remains primary. The course-to-endpoint relation is inferred from supplied context and connections; the future particle itself is not made to mean giving or ease.

epistemic.reason: Trusted publication and legacy wide-walk support share the focus branch; the transfer from the preceding course to the final state remains an explicit contextual inference.
